## Plugin reference

- Description: plugin-records-write-lost report kind: validates the shared record store's lost-write payloads (filed through the report outbox by the store itself, one row per cause) and renders a task naming the process, the records lost and how its writes waited in the writer line and held the lock. Warning, re-arms daily.
